request.deadline: instantly performed as part of the governance action's enactment on-chain
deliverables: On-chain distribution of funds to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.recipient: the Ikigai Info governance action submitter
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action and compensate alleged lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal states that an Info governance action titled "Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai -" was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The proposer says the Ikigai action was symbolic and asked the community to agree with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
The proposer claims a Cardano node bug allowed an unregistered stake key to be used, preventing the submitter from recovering a 100,000 ADA governance action deposit.
The proposal claims there was significant community sentiment at the time that the deposit should be reimbursed because the submitter was an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
The proposer states that entity-based budget submissions did not include this reimbursement after treasury withdrawal capability became available following the Plomin hard fork.
The proposal states that the Cardano in Oceania initiative included the reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that action was not approved.
The requested 103,000 ADA consists of the alleged lost 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for staking rewards calculated at 2% per annum.
The proposer claims the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposer claims the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal provides an external governance reference URI that may allow checking the referenced Ikigai governance action.

summary: The document requests 103,000 ADA to reimburse an alleged unrecoverable 100,000 ADA governance action deposit and 3,000 ADA in staking rewards, but most key factual and treasury claims are asserted with limited supporting analysis.
